items.q: Is this the same as running ads?
items.a: No. These are organic placements on pages people already follow. The clips do double as excellent ad creative if you want to boost them.

items.q: How do I know it worked?
items.a: You get a placement report, where each clip ran, the reach it earned, and you will see it in your branded search volume within weeks.
